_about: NFR-06: reviewed exceptions to the npm audit job (scripts/npm-audit.mjs). Each entry needs a reason and a review_by date (at most 90 days ahead); past that date it fails CI again.

entries.reason: Pulled in by tailwindcss 3 (NativeWind's compiler) through chokidar and micromatch. It runs only at build time on our own source globs, never in the POS app or on a server, and has no fixed release in the tailwindcss 3 line NativeWind 4 needs.
Used by @expo/cli for development-server and code-signing certificates. Not part of the app bundle or any server; upgrade with the next Expo SDK that moves off node-forge 1.4.
